newsitem.title: USA: Fed considers CPI bias in setting policy - Greenspan.
newsitem.headline: Fed considers CPI bias in setting policy - Greenspan.

text.p: The Federal Reserve takes account of the upward bias in the consumer price index (CPI) in setting monetary policy, central bank Chairman Alan Greenspan said on Thursday.

While acknowledging that the real level of the federal funds rate would be higher if the CPI were adjusted downwards, Greenspan argued that such a move would not change the central bank's overall assessment of its policy stance.
That is because the bias in the CPI has been long-standing and has not changed dramatically over time, he told the Senate Finance Committee.
